benchmark_scaled_index_add: benchmark the xformers scaled_index_add forward pass against PyTorch baseline with configurable shapes and scaling
benchmark_scaled_index_add_fwbw: benchmark the xformers scaled_index_add forward and backward pass against PyTorch baseline with configurable shapes and scaling
benchmark_index_select_fw: benchmark the xformers index_select_cat forward pass against PyTorch baseline with configurable batches and keep ratios
benchmark_index_select_fwbw: benchmark the xformers index_select_cat forward and backward pass against PyTorch baseline with configurable batches and keep ratios
create_benchmark_case: create a benchmark case dict with shape, scaling, and dtype parameters for scaled_index_add or index_select benchmarks
